tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere: app shell, client form, mobile screens. Warm ivory by day, near-black by night; never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table bodies, drawers, dialogs, popovers, the mobile task card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table header rows, category bands on S7, input wells, list-row hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, sections and cards. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes, toggles and the outline button (3.6:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and gold-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, vendor and venue lines, column headers, labels. 5.8:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Icons, disabled text, placeholders and the '—' in empty grid cells. 3.3–3.9:1 in light, so never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ink. The primary action fill: Save service, Send to planner, Done. One primary button per view. Inverts to ivory in dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills (17:1 light, 15.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Antique gold, the signature. Selected-tab and active-nav indicator bar, active function chip border, progress fill, links, the hairline under the event header, the company monogram on S1. Never a status colour and never a large fill.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, ticked service card on S1, today's function in switchers, the selected nav item background. Text on it is ink; gold text on it is 5.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline at 2px offset on every focusable element; 5.3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Peacock teal. Done tasks, Planned badge, amount left under envelope. Always with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and the Done group band.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Burnt marigold. 'edited' pax and 'changed' vendor tags, Next up group, envelope 90% used. Always as a word tag; reads close to gold in lightness, so never place warning and gold side by side without a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning tags and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Kumkum crimson. Over envelope, over budget, Overdue, Issue, destructive actions. Always with the ⚠ icon or the word 'over'; warning and danger differ in hue, so the word carries the meaning.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges, the Overdue band and the destructive-confirm panel.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Client form hero and empty-state headlines only. One per screen at most.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Event name in the event header; dashboard greeting; mobile Today function name.

styles.name: title-serif
styles.usage: Vendor name on the profile, function name in By-function view, drawer titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and card headings inside screens.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text on web, table cells, descriptions.

styles.name: body-touch
styles.usage: All mobile text and every input on mobile (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Service names in plan rows, task titles, emphasised cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, chips, tabs, badges, table column headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, 'used in 6 events'. Never below 12px.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Category bands on S1 and S7, task group headers (OVERDUE, NEXT UP). Uppercase via CSS, written in sentence case in source.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Every amount, quantity and time in tables. Tabular figures, right-aligned.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Headline cards on Summary and Dashboard (Budget, Planned, Left).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding-x, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gap, mobile screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and drawer padding on web, gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Web page gutter; gap between major sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page to first heading; client form hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty states and the client form thank-you page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, tags, badges, table selection.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the mobile task card, menus. Also shadcn --radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers (S8), dialogs, mobile bottom sheets, client form service cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Function chips, filter chips, progress bars, avatar-free status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, popovers, menus and toasts only. Resting UI uses border, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, the sticky 'Send to planner' bar and the mobile header once content scrolls under them.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense controls inside plan tables and filters (web).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height on web.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Every tappable control on mobile (S1, S12): Done, Call, Issue, Send to planner.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows on S7, S9, S10, S11, S14.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Planner web sidebar, expanded.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: S8 service drawer and other right-side sheets on web.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width inside the shell; tables may go full width.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Client form (S1) column width on large screens.
